status: Engagement consoles from the SAM Simulator manual, corrected by the Polish Osa-AK manual (mon_2112_80) and the Soviet 1991 textbook (voenizdat_osa_1991). Power-up, deploy and stow follow the textbook's crew drill ('К бою', pp. 246–248) and the power cabinet's timers; see docs/research/OSA_MANUALS_2026-10.md.
notes: Positions, labels and procedure order come from the manual and the game's control sprites; start positions were measured in the running game (samsim_game, docs/research/OSA_CONSOLE_MAP_2026-10.md §12). Controls whose function isn't known are present but inert (no subsystem uses them). Timings are only included where a source gives them.

sources.notes: Used where no source gives the detail. Always with confidence 'estimate' and a note saying what it is based on.

stations.label: Commander
stations.notes: Officer; front cab beside the driver. Receives designations from the battery PU-12 by radio and gives the orders. The АПУ controls here are SAM3D placements (their real seat isn't known); power is the driver's (PU-303, rwd_mb3).

stations.label: Deputy commander
stations.notes: Launch console (key, ПУСК ГОТОВ, missile selection), elevation wheel and dial, TV monitor. Control ids keep SAM Simulator's 'fo.' (Firing Officer) prefix.

stations.label: Senior operator
stations.notes: Search radar (SOC) scope, IFF, azimuth wheel: puts the target under the SSC azimuth line.

stations.label: Operator
stations.notes: Range indicator and range wheel; SSC transmitter and capture (ТСЦ). The NVA senior operator also sets the range mark on the search scope; SAM3D has one range wheel, so it is the operator's (sam3d).

stations.label: Driver
stations.notes: Front cab. Works the power supply: the power-supply control panel PU-303 is at his left (rwd_mb3).

launch.notes: Restarts: after a launch ПУСК ГОТОВ goes out and lights again when the next missile can be launched (p30). The manual gives no time; SAM3D repeats missile preparation (the 15 s spin-up), confidence estimate.

launcher.source: flak11 (NVA Osa-AK: at ВНИМАНИЕ the command transmitter comes on and two missiles are selected automatically, outer ones first, left and right; K3 about 120 m before the target); samsim_thread (creator: ЗАХВАТ about 0.8 s / 60 m after launch; ePap: the lamp sequence, К3 with УЗКИЙ ЛУЧ against a jamming target); korovin_tiv_2010 (the two missiles launched 3-5 s apart, each captured by its own wide- and medium-beam antennas); samsim_osa p30 (ПУСК ГОТОВ again for the second missile)
launcher.notes: Channel 1 = I (right launcher), 2 = II (left). 'Outer first': container 3 is taken as the outer one, from the order of the ИЗДЕЛИЯ selector (3-II ... 1-II, ОТКЛ., 1-I ... 3-I); sam3d estimate. In СОВМ. channel I fires first (sam3d estimate). medium_s and narrow_s (when СР.Л and УЗКИЙ ЛУЧ light) are sam3d estimates; min_interval_s 4 is inside Korovin's 3-5 s. The lamps stay lit as the missile goes through the beams and go out when the shot is over. nominal_flight_s only applies without the outcome model. Reloading: with tzm_alongside set and the vehicle stopped, one missile goes into an empty container every reload_s_per_missile (60 s: flak11's 6 min for six), outer containers first, only once the pair is spent and no channel is guiding; the 60 s per missile is the 6 min divided by six (the crane's three-container traverse is not modelled), the loading order is a sam3d estimate. Gyro overheating (flashing ammunition lamps) and the emergency launch are not modelled.

powered.description: powered on the march: turbine running, equipment and stabilisation warm, search possible on the move
powered.source: wrk (search possible on the move); mon_2112_80 p11-12 (readiness within 4 min); video_osa (a powered battery deploys in 35-50 s, unverified)
powered.notes: What a battery on the march with the equipment already running looks like. The function check is not counted as done.

deployed.description: deployed at a halt: on the take-off generator, launcher unlocked, drives on, vehicle oriented
deployed.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p246-247 (readiness drill: power, deploy, orientation); flak11
deployed.notes: A vehicle in a firing position, waiting for targets with the radars silent.

sensors.notes: Maps the SOC, SSC and TOV onto this console for the gameplay engagement model (simcore/engagement.hpp). Gameplay thresholds live in data/gameplay/osa_ak.json.

beams.source: flak11 and korovin_tiv_2010 (33 rpm; the beam is switched to one of three positions each turn); samsim_osa p15 (selector: ЛУЧ I, II, III, АВТ. I-III, АВТ. I-II); mon_2112_80 p15, p21
beams.notes: Positions of soc.beam: I, II, III hold one beam; АВТ. I-III steps through all three, one per turn, and АВТ. I-II through the lower two. The rings are the ePap rings (samsim_thread): the 0-15 km scale has them at 2, 7 and 12 km, the others every 5 km from the origin (SAM3D reads that as multiples of 5 km inside the window).

iff.source: mon_2112_80 p21 (general interrogation ЗАПРОС and ЗАПРОС К: the reply is a 20° arc on the PPI; or the gated mode, where the search echo gates the reply and the mark is much narrower), p14 (the interrogator NRZ's antenna is built into the search antenna); voenizdat_osa_1991 p17 (a reply puts a «свой» mark beside the echo), p55 (ЗАПРОС К is a control interrogation confirming a friend), p53 (identification range at least 30 km, 1L24-2), p56 (1 s per press)
iff.notes: The interrogator works with the search radar radiating (SAM3D). Range and query time are the 1991 textbook's for the AKM's 1L24-2; the Osa-AK's interrogator may differ. Gated mode: КЛАПАН.

search.notes: Scales p15 item 5; СДЦ works to 35 km, p15 item 12.

elevation_search.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p95 (in ЦУ the SSC antenna searches in elevation within the search beam the target was detected in; the OS81-10M auto-capture circuit, armed by ЦУ and АЗ, fires when the target is in the antenna's beam and the range gate is on it), p86 (the scan comes from self-oscillation of the elevation drive; beam commands I, II, III from the search radar), Fig. 2.37 p97 (beam I −1° to 5°, II 3° to 9°, III 6° to 30°); korovin_tiv_2010 (tracking beam 1°)
elevation_search.notes: Scan period: SAM3D estimate. In the automatic beam programmes (АВТ. I–III, I–II) SAM3D searches the beam the search radar sees the target in nearest the azimuth line (the real scan follows the search radar's beam commands). mon_2112_80 p21 gives I–II as 0–8° and I–III as 0–28°: the textbook's figure is used.

track.notes: SSC displayed range 28 km (p16); ±330° azimuth (p14, p16; voenizdat_osa_1991 p66; mon_2112_80 p25 gives ±342° for the turret). TV fields 00-60 x 00-80 (3.6 x 4.8°) wide and 00-18 x 00-24 (1.08 x 1.44°) narrow (voenizdat_osa_1991 p101; an operator on samsim_thread gives the same); the larger figure is used. SAM Simulator's manual gives 5° / 1.5°. fov_height_ratio 0.75 is the height over the width of those fields (00-60 over 00-80), used for the lens field in manual TV tracking.

orientation.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p48 (gyro half-compass GA-3 measures the vehicle's heading Qc once oriented; the Qc found with an artillery compass and the TV sight by mutual sighting is set on the setter ЗК-4; with АК — ЗК at ЗК and РЕЛЕ — Qc at Qc the setter is connected and the correction motor turns the GA-3; СОГЛАСОВАНИЕ speeds it up; agreement is checked on the Qc scale of OR-31M, which stops), p50–52 (block 0005-8M), p246 (the deputy crew chief orients the vehicle at a halt), p249 (Qc: clockwise from north to the vehicle's axis); mon_2112_80 pp. 63–68 (orientation is lost when the equipment is switched off)
orientation.notes: Rates are SAM3D estimates. The GA-3 runs on vehicle power (SAM3D); without it, the frame starts again taking the hull to face north. Holding СОГЛАСОВАНИЕ is one press in SAM3D: the fast turn continues until the scales agree. Gyro drift is not modelled.

controls.label: ГТА (gas-turbine power unit)
controls.source: wrk (9И120 unit powers the vehicle on the move and at a halt); station: rwd_mb3 (power-supply control panel PU-303 at the driver's left); control: sam3d
controls.notes: The unit is real, and the power system's control panel PU-303 is the driver's (medium). Its labels can't be read in any picture found, so one on/off switch stands in for the start sequence.

controls.label: power take-off generator
controls.source: wrk (engine-driven generator, at a halt only); control: sam3d
controls.notes: Real control and label not known.

controls.label: походный стопор АПУ (АПУ travel lock)
controls.source: wrk (АПУ locked on the march, unlocked at a halt); voenizdat_osa_1991 p247 (the deputy orders 'Расстопорить АПУ', the operator unlocks it), p100 (lamps РАССТОПОРЕНО βн and βн ЗАСТОПОР.)
controls.notes: Unlocking also switches the antenna stabilisation from standby to combat work (mon_2112_80 p22). The lock's actual handle or switch isn't described; one switch stands in for it.

controls.label: ПРОХОД ПОД МОСТОМ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p50 (buttons ПРОХОД ПОД МОСТОМ ВКЛ. / ВЫКЛ. on the stowing panel lower and raise the search antenna on the move without switching stabilisation off); station: mon_2112_80 Fig. 3 (antenna-lowering board at the commander's seat)
controls.notes: Two push-buttons modelled as one switch; starts at ВЫКЛ. (antenna allowed up). Folding the turret for Il-76 or rail transport is done with a lifting device (mon_2112_80 p25), not from the cabin.

controls.label: люки (hatches)
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p99 (РУ lights only with ЛЮКИ ЗАКР. lit on the commander's console), p154 (ПУСК ГОТОВ needs the hatches closed); mon_2112_80 p64 (hatches must not be opened in combat work)
controls.notes: The hatches have a powered opening and closing system (voenizdat_osa_1991 p163). One control stands for all of them; starts closed.

controls.label: АРРЕТИР.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p247 (the driver erects the gyro by holding АРРЕТИР. on block 0005-8M for 40 s), p51–52
controls.notes: Block 0005-8M is on rack SŁ-1M at the front of the operators' compartment (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3). SAM3D: one press starts the 40 s erection.

controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p48, p246 (ЗК connects the course setter ЗК-4 to the gyro for orientation; back to АК afterwards)

procedures.name: Orient the vehicle (gyro half-compass to the crew chief's Qc)
procedures.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p246 (drill: the deputy crew chief sets АК — ЗК to ЗК, the commanded Qc on ЗК-4, РЕЛЕ — Qc to Qc, holds СОГЛАСОВАНИЕ until the Qc scale on OR-31M stops, then АК and РЕЛЕ), p48, p249 (the crew chief finds Qc with an artillery compass)
procedures.notes: Deputy commander, at a halt, once the gyros are up (the driver's АРРЕТИР.). The crew chief's Qc goes on the setter after ЗК (an NPC deputy sets it there; the player is told it in the log). Orientation is lost when the equipment is switched off.

steps.description: АК — ЗК to ЗК, then set the crew chief's Qc on the course setter ЗК-4
РЕЛЕ — Qc to Qc
Press and hold СОГЛАСОВАНИЕ until the Qc scale on OR-31M stops
Scales agree: АК — ЗК back to АК
РЕЛЕ — Qc back to РЕЛЕ
